blueprint.title: SkillsBridge — Work-Evidence to HR Skill Attribution Console
blueprint.persona: HR Capability Lead & Team Engineering Manager
blueprint.businessProblem: Northstar has work evidence scattered across resolved IT incidents and incomplete HR skill profiles. Automatic AI attribution risks assigning unverified skills and eroding employee trust. We need a human-in-the-loop review workspace where reviewers inspect incident evidence alongside fixed ESCO skill references, approve or reject the current revision, suppress duplicate syncs, and recover cleanly from HR destination 429/503 outages.

requirements.title: Current-Revision Evidence Inspection
requirements.statement: Display resolved incident evidence, identity mapping status, and candidate ESCO skill URI with exact revision fingerprint.

requirements.title: Human Review Gate (Approve / Reject)
requirements.statement: Require explicit human reviewer decision with mandatory rationale before any skill suggestion can be queued for HR sync.

requirements.title: Idempotent HR Sync & Outage Recovery
requirements.statement: Suppress duplicate revision writes and provide bounded retry controls when the destination HR endpoint returns HTTP 429 or 503.

requirements.title: Filter by Verification Status & Identity Match
requirements.statement: Allow filtering candidate evidence by Pending Review, Approved, Rejected, or Identity Blocked.

requirements.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility & Keyboard Triage
requirements.statement: Maintain >= 4.5:1 text contrast, explicit aria-labels, semantic landmarks, and full keyboard focus visibility.

requirements.title: Explicit Empty, Loading & Error States
requirements.statement: Provide dedicated, testable UI states for empty queues, skeleton loading, and simulated 503 destination outages.

userStories.iWant: to verify incident resolution evidence against the ESCO skill definition and approve only the current revision
userStories.soThat: no unverified or stale AI inference is written to an employee HR profile
acceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate skill inference in status PENDING_REVIEW with revision rev-84a2
When the reviewer inspects the incident evidence and clicks "Approve Revision"
Then the item status transitions to APPROVED, records the reviewer timestamp, and unlocks HR synchronization.

userStories.iWant: to see a clear recovery banner with idempotency key protection when the HR destination returns HTTP 503
userStories.soThat: retrying a failed sync never creates duplicate skill entries
acceptanceCriteria: Given an approved skill item whose first sync attempt failed with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable
When the operator clicks "Retry Idempotent Sync"
Then the system reuses the existing idempotency key, completes the single write, and logs 50% attempt success.

userStories.iWant: to filter blocked identities and keyboard-navigate through pending items with high-contrast badges
userStories.soThat: I can audit exceptions rapidly while meeting enterprise accessibility standards
acceptanceCriteria: Given the review queue contains PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED, and IDENTITY_BLOCKED items
When I select the "Identity Blocked" filter segment
Then only blocked records are shown and the identity mismatch reason is announced via aria-live.

redesignedPairs.label: Primary Body Text on Surface (#0F172A on #FFFFFF)
Muted Metadata Text on App Background (#475569 on #F8FAFC)

legacyIssuesRemediated.description: Legacy status badges and muted helper text used #94A3B8 on #F8FAFC (contrast 2.34:1, fails WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1).
Legacy prototype only rendered the happy-path table; 503 HR sync outage and empty review queue states were missing.
Approve and Sync actions were combined into a single unconfirmed click without showing the ESCO URI or revision hash.

dimensions.beforeState: Partial (only happy-path table represented; 3/6 requirements missing)
dimensions.afterState: 6/6 FR & NFR requirements mapped in Traceability Matrix
dimensions.evidence: FR-01 -> EvidenceInspectionCard, FR-02 -> ReviewerDecisionBar, FR-03 -> SyncOutageRecoveryBanner, FR-04 -> StatusFilterSegmentedControl, NFR-01 -> AccessibleWorkspaceShell, NFR-02 -> StateSwitcherToolbar

dimensions.beforeState: Fragmented across modal popups without persistent context
dimensions.afterState: Structured High-Density Operations Matrix with segmented status filter and persistent inspection rail

dimensions.beforeState: Single unconfirmed click with no revision or idempotency guard
dimensions.afterState: 3 end-to-end Gherkin user stories (Triage, Approval, Idempotent Recovery)

dimensions.beforeState: Missing empty state and missing HTTP 503 outage recovery banner
dimensions.afterState: All 4 operational states (INTERACTIVE, EMPTY, LOADING, ERROR) explicitly implemented and switchable
All token pairs pass WCAG 2.1 AA (min 6.7:1 >= 4.5:1) + semantic landmarks & focus rings

dimensions.beforeState: Arbitrary unmapped colors and inconsistent border radii
dimensions.afterState: 100% mapped to Northstar Enterprise Design System v2.4.0 (10px cards, 6px controls)
dimensions.evidence: Tailwind config + CSS custom properties verified

dimensions.beforeState: Leaked prototype scaffolding, mock Unsplash URLs, and default exports
dimensions.afterState: Named TypeScript exports, zero `any`, strict Tailwind import order, clean data interface
